name: IP_NORMALIZATION_V1
steps: reject empty input and any '%' zone/interface suffix in Beta 1.0
parse with Python stdlib ipaddress.ip_address; host addresses only, not CIDR/network text
emit family 4 or 6 and canonical compressed lowercase text
before insert/update check exact canonical duplicate on same Network Element
query cross-Network-Element same canonical address as duplicate candidates/warnings only
primary selection is a separate reviewed relation/event and revalidates at-most-one current primary
rules: IPv4 leading-zero ambiguous forms follow stdlib rejection rather than permissive reinterpretation
IPv4-mapped IPv6 remains the canonical IPv6 form returned by ipaddress and is not silently collapsed to IPv4
loopback/link-local/private/public semantics may be displayed as descriptive diagnostics but never block identity or infer topology unless a future contract says so
IP absence is valid and no address is synthesized
address correction preserves IP relationship identity/event history; a genuinely separate address may receive separate network_element_ip_id
